Class MappingJacksonValue

java.lang.Object
org.springframework.http.converter.json.MappingJacksonValue
@Deprecated(since="7.0", forRemoval=true) public class MappingJacksonValue extends Object
Deprecated, for removal: This API element is subject to removal in a future version.
自 7.0 版本起，建议使用 `SmartHttpMessageConverter` 提示。
A simple holder for the POJO to serialize via MappingJackson2HttpMessageConverter along with further serialization instructions to be passed in to the converter.

在服务器端，此包装器会在内容协商选择要使用的转换器之后但在写入之前，通过 `ResponseBodyInterceptor` 添加。

在客户端，只需将 POJO 包装起来并传递给 `RestTemplate`。

Since:
4.1
Author:
Rossen Stoyanchev
